scenario: M3 calibration inlet-buffer sensitivity with 80%-coverage upstream proxy
assumptions: Simulation time 00:15 corresponds to 07:00 after a 15-minute warmup.
Mainline inlet uses station 400790 at at least 80% reported coverage; comparison targets retain at least 90% coverage.
The existing motorway buffer is about 1 km upstream of the M2 analysis start; omitted upstream exits and inlet imputation are uncertainties.
PeMS five-minute flow is multiplied by 12 to obtain vehicles per hour.
Measured Mathilda exit demand is removed from the through flow; measured Mathilda, Moffett, and San Antonio entrances are injected on audited edges.
Missing-entrance groups are assumed demand, and other omitted ramps remain unknown.
PeMS speed is a comparison target and is not imposed on vehicles.
Mainline routes follow ordered motorway checkpoints; passengers in managed lanes are assumed eligible or toll-paying.
Human behavior uses stochastic Krauss following and the default lane-changing model.
additional_assumptions: Station 400790 with at least 80% reported coverage supplies an inlet proxy; comparison targets retain 90% coverage.
The 1.008 km existing motorway buffer precedes the M2 analysis start. Its flow may include omitted upstream exits; its exact lane paint is not certified.
Measured speed is not imposed on vehicles; the buffer tests whether the prior inlet suppressed upstream congestion.
